WITH tmp_proc_mat AS ( SELECT po_no, SUM(order_qty) AS mat_Comp_Qty FROM dbo.TB_WORK_ORDER_PROC WHERE proc_cd = 'PRC002' GROUP BY po_no ) SELECT a.mat_reg_date ,a.po_no ,a.item_cd ,b.item_name ,a.qty ,isnull(a.theory_Make_Qty, 0) as theoryMakeQty ,isnull(a.mat_Instr_Qty, 0) as matInstrQty ,isnull(a.mat_Instr_Qty, 0) - ISNULL(c.mat_Comp_Qty, 0) AS resMatQty ,a.mat_plan_date ,isnull(a.mat_Instr_Qty,0) - (isnull(a.mat_Instr_Qty,0) - ISNULL(c.mat_Comp_Qty, 0)) as minQty ,ISNULL(c.mat_Comp_Qty, 0) AS matCompQty ,a.etc ,a.mat_In_Yn ,a.end_yn ,a.mat_plan_id FROM tb_mat_plan a JOIN tb_item_mst b ON b.item_cd = a.item_cd LEFT JOIN tmp_proc_mat c ON c.po_no = a.po_no WHERE 1=1
AND a.mat_reg_date between #{strDate} AND #{endDate}
and a.item_cd = #{itemCd}
and b.item_name LIKE '%' + #{itemName} + '%'
AND (ISNULL(a.mat_Instr_Qty,0) - ISNULL(c.mat_Comp_Qty, 0)) > 0
AND (ISNULL(a.mat_Instr_Qty,0) - ISNULL(c.mat_Comp_Qty, 0)) <= 0
ORDER BY a.mat_reg_date desc

SELECT a.mat_reg_date ,a.po_no ,a.item_cd ,b.item_name ,a.qty ,isnull(a.theory_Make_Qty, 0) as theoryMakeQty ,isnull(a.mat_Instr_Qty, 0) as matInstrQty ,a.mat_plan_date ,a.etc ,a.mat_in_yn ,a.end_yn ,a.mat_plan_id FROM tb_mat_plan a JOIN dbo.tb_item_mst b ON b.item_cd = a.item_cd WHERE a.mat_plan_id = #{matPlanId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_mat_plan ( mat_reg_date, po_no, item_cd, qty, theory_make_qty, mat_instr_qty, mat_plan_date, etc, mat_in_yn, end_yn, reg_id, upd_id ) VALUES ( #{matRegDate}, #{poNo}, #{itemCd}, #{qty}, #{theoryMakeQty}, #{matInstrQty}, #{matPlanDate}, #{etc}, 'N', 'N', #{userId}, #{userId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_mat_plan SET mat_reg_date = #{matRegDate}, item_cd = #{itemCd}, qty = #{qty}, theory_make_qty = #{theoryMakeQty}, mat_instr_qty = #{matInstrQty}, mat_plan_date = #{matPlanDate}, etc = #{etc}, upd_id = #{userId}, upd_dt = GETDATE() WHERE mat_plan_id = #{matPlanId}
UPDATE tb_mat_plan SET end_yn = #{endYn}, upd_id = #{userId}, upd_dt = GETDATE() WHERE mat_plan_id = #{matPlanId}
UPDATE tb_mat_plan SET mat_in_yn = #{matInYn}, upd_id = #{userId}, upd_dt = GETDATE() WHERE mat_plan_id = #{matPlanId}
